title: Sauma attestation envelope v1
description: A Sauma envelope attests one local artifact without indexing or persistence. Evolution rules: new optional fields are additive within v1; provenance kind is an open enumeration and walkers must tolerate unknown kinds, using any digest/token/oid/id/ref linking value they understand. Any breaking change requires docs/schemas/sauma-envelope.v2.schema.json plus a new envelope id. The digest is sha256 over the artifact's sauma canonical form: take the artifact with its top-level sauma field removed, then serialize as compact UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically at every level (sorted keys and compact spacing only; no number or unicode normalization). A producer must sort keys explicitly rather than rely on any serde_json default so that any walker recomputes the same digest regardless of the producer's key ordering.

envelope.description: Envelope schema id. Version 1 is the only value emitted by this schema.

schema.description: Schema id of the artifact carrying this envelope.

digest.description: sha256-prefixed digest of the carrying artifact serialized without its sauma field.

provenance.description: Edges this artifact was produced from. Known kinds include git oids, consistency tokens, and other artifact digests; producers may emit other kind values, and walkers must ignore unknown edges they cannot link.

producer.description: Tool identity that produced the artifact.

run.description: Session or run id that produced the artifact, when known.

anchored_at.description: sha256-prefixed consistency token anchoring the artifact to a repo state.

kind.description: Unknown provenance edge kind. Kind is open; walkers may use id-like fields when present.
